enrollments.intro: Students register for a course from their account. Accept or reject each registration; when the course is over, mark it done — the student can then request their certificate and rate the course from their account. Each decision is shown to the student, with your note, and emailed when email is set up.
enrollments.completeCourseHint: Marks the course done for every accepted student at once. Pending and rejected registrations are left as they are.
enrollments.completeConfirm: Mark “{{course}}” as done for every accepted student?
enrollments.completedCount_one: The course was marked done for {{count}} student.
enrollments.completedCount_other: The course was marked done for {{count}} students.
enrollments.notePlaceholder: Shown in their account and in the email — e.g. the start date, or why they were not accepted
enrollments.done.completed: Marked done — the student can now request the certificate and rate the course.
questions.intro: The questions students answer when they rate a course they completed. Write each in Arabic (and English), choose how it is answered, and whether it is asked on every course or only some. A question that already has answers is better retired (untick “In use”) than deleted, so its results stay readable.
questions.empty: No questions yet. Add the first one.
questions.needOptions: A choice question needs at least two options.
questions.deleteConfirm: Delete this question? If students have answered it, consider retiring it instead.
results.intro: What students said about the courses they completed. Star questions show the average and how the stars spread; choices show how many picked each option; written answers are listed in full.
results.emptyHint: They appear here once students rate a course they completed.
results.cardRatingHint: The students’ average, shown on the site.
